rules.description: Modules may only import from their own module or from modules lower in the layer order: cli > platform > core.
rules.rationale: A fixed dependency direction keeps lower layers reusable and stops circular knowledge between areas of the app.

rules.description: Modules must not depend on each other in a cycle.
rules.rationale: Cycles make modules impossible to change, test or extract on their own.

rules.description: Code must not load modules in a way that hides which ones, such as import() of a variable.
rules.rationale: What cannot be told from the code cannot be checked, so such an import can break any other rule unnoticed.

rules.description: Source files should stay under 600 lines.
rules.rationale: Very large files usually mix responsibilities and are hard for humans and agents to change safely.
